title.narrative: Center for social and media initiatives / Zero Waste Academy 2021-2022
Center for social and media initiatives / Zero Waste Academy 2021-2022

description.narrative: increased number of eco-conscious and eco-literate citizens who take responsibility for their waste. - reduced number of spontaneous landfills due to the pool of local experts and environmental trainers with a creative approach (this is important because the usual format of lectures is not successful in the information society). - transition from the educational stage to the practical one. - an increase in society's requests for infrastructure solutions, and preparation of the society for the introduction of a system of expanded business responsibility. - due to the on-line training sessions, the maximum number of participants (until 100 people) is attracted to the project. - 6 projects of practical waste management solutions (2 per one mentor) were implemented at the local level. - at the end of the project, based on experience with various case studies of Ukraine, a manual for self-education and the application of various practices at the local level is prepared. - pages in social networks are created. - more than 15 publications in the media. - press releases were prepared and 2 press conferences were held, the general conference was held with the presentation of participants projects, summing up the project and presenting participants of ZWA (for being eco-trainers). Also Zero Waste Academy site is presented (including materials from previous course 2020-2021)
